text.name: Belt and Road
text.rules: Record "corridors". If LIO played this card, SAE spends 2 points on one action; otherwise, SAE spends 3 points on one action. LIO chooses: Challenge the loan terms? If yes, until the end of this turn, each time LIO spends points, it spends 1 fewer, never below 1, then at the end of this turn, LIO spends 1 point on actions; if no, record "unanswered".
text.history: China's leader announced the "Silk Road Economic Belt" in Astana on 7 September 2013 and a maritime counterpart in Jakarta that October; in December 2017 Sri Lanka handed the Chinese-financed port of Hambantota to a Chinese company on a 99-year lease.
